what_absence_means_from_the_writer.value: A row exists only for a day that HAD settlements. `persistable_day_rows` builds its tuples from `daily_series(rows)`, so a day with no settlement rows produces no tuple and therefore no row. Absence is therefore 'no settlements', NOT 'not looked at' -- provided the day fell inside a written range.
what_absence_means_from_the_writer.src: backend/sportsassets/api/venue_truth.py:618 persistable_day_rows, and :680 the upsert, which also states 'A venue that failed to fetch must not overwrite its rows with zeros -- only venues that actually produced data write.'

the_pagination_guard_that_does_exist.value: `pm_persist_bounds` returns the ET days the crawl PROVABLY holds in full as a (first_day, before_day) pair, 'or None when no day is provable and the ledger must not be written', and a capped crawl's partial edge day is excluded. So the writer already refuses to record days it cannot prove it covered.

the_residual_uncertainty_i_could_not_clo.value: The crawl does NOT persist its provable range. Section 7 looked for any crawl cursor, page or coverage row and found only `bettor_live_probe_state` and three `rn1x_*` cursors -- nothing for venue truth. So `pm_persist_bounds`'s answer is computed per run and discarded, and WHETHER A GIVEN PAST DAY WAS INSIDE A WRITTEN RANGE CANNOT BE VERIFIED AFTER THE FACT.
the_residual_uncertainty_i_could_not_clo.consequence: Sep 21-22 are therefore UNRESOLVED, not explained. The writer's semantics make 'no settlements' the most likely reading, and it is consistent with the account opening no orders after Sep 11 and holding fewer positions to resolve. But a pair of days that no crawl provably covered would look identical, and nothing on file distinguishes them.
the_residual_uncertainty_i_could_not_clo.what_would_close_it: persist pm_persist_bounds' (first_day, before_day) per crawl run. Then a missing day inside a recorded range is 'no settlements' and one outside it is 'never covered', and the question stops recurring every week.

a_discriminator_that_did_not_work.value: I intended to settle it with a second, independent source: orders WE settled on a missing day. Section 3 returned 0 orders for both days -- but live_orders is silent for the ENTIRE week (no lane wrote after Sep 11), so it returns 0 for Sep 23-27 as well, which DO have venue-truth rows. The discriminator is vacuous over this window and I am reporting it as such rather than quoting its answer.

items.title: Probe export failure - UNRESOLVED
items.what: The engine-diagnostic probe dispatched for this edition (run 2513) had its blob-emitting step cancelled at its 32-minute watchdog. The export blobs (SLBLOB, LOBLOB, RRBLOB, WDBLOB) were never emitted.
items.consequence: Every section that folds from those blobs -- sleeve detail, ladders, equity curves, account balances -- is OMITTED rather than estimated.
items.cause: NOT ESTABLISHED. The step reached its watchdog; why it took longer than 32 minutes is unknown. It is recorded as an unresolved export failure and not as a timing note, and it stays unresolved until the cause is established.
items.not_claimed: that this is a runner-wide problem, and not that it is confined to the probe. Neither has been shown.

items.title: Sep 21 and Sep 22 - UNRESOLVED
items.what: No venue-truth rows for either day, in an otherwise dense 51-of-53-day history.
items.cause: NOT ESTABLISHED. See the coverage block: the writer's semantics make 'no settlements' the most likely reading, but the crawl does not persist its provable range, so whether those days were ever inside a written range cannot be verified after the fact.

items.title: No trading since 2026-09-11
items.what: No lane has written an order since 2026-09-11. The week's realized P&L is run-off of earlier inventory, not the result of activity in the week.
items.cause: the autonomous lane runs continuously and admits nothing; the funded book is empty and funded submission ships disabled. This is reported as the operating state, not as a performance result.

what_this_edition_does_not_claim: that -$794.01 is a week total. It is a five-day subtotal and two days are unresolved.
that any part of it belongs to the autonomous EV engine. That engine's ledger holds zero intents and it has never sent an order.
that the two missing days are explained. The most likely reading is named and so is the reason it cannot be confirmed.
that the probe export failure is understood. Its cause is not established.
that internal bookkeeping and venue truth can be compared directly. They are different bases and are kept apart.
